hypotheses.claim: Cross-component security gates must consume a typed executable contract/schema or behavior receipt, not raw source-substring assertions that break under semantically equivalent refactors.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Raw source-string assertions are a sufficient and lower-cost integration contract.
hypotheses.falsifier: Refactor the token-ingress implementation without changing its auth/scope behavior. A typed contract gate must remain green while wrong auth scheme, missing scope, channel collapse and provenance loss fail. Rerun the full web-ingress discriminator on accepted target and inspect exact result/artifact hashes.

hypotheses.claim: The integrity identity of open-web evidence must bind the entire validated parsed projection and fixed non-authority fields, not raw-source hash alone.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: A raw-source hash plus schema validation is sufficient because parsed projections are deterministic.
hypotheses.falsifier: Mutate extracted fields after parsing while retaining source hash; require denial. Then attack a compromised parser able to recompute hashes, downstream provenance stripping, adaptive model-mediated injection and visual/screenshot injection; the hypothesis fails as end-to-end protection if any route mints instruction/effect authority.

hypotheses.claim: Recovered source and evaluation logic do not constitute an executable comparison baseline unless exact or explicitly reconstructed weights, dependencies, fixtures and protocols are provenance-bound.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: A source-equivalent environment with substitute generic weights is sufficient for original-versus-successor comparison.
hypotheses.falsifier: Recover exact weight hashes or document deterministic reconstruction separately; sanitize/freeze fixture hashes and ground truth; reproduce cold/warm historical behavior on accepted target. Any substitute artifact must be labeled reconstructed and may not support an original-baseline replacement claim.

hypotheses.claim: Text and visual open-web paths must conserve a fixed UNTRUSTED_EXTERNAL_DATA/non-authority label through cognition to every effect sink; structural text success alone cannot close the Retina path.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Securing the textual transport boundary is sufficient because screenshots are converted to text before action planning.
hypotheses.falsifier: Run matched nested-authority attacks through raw text, parsed DOM and rendered screenshots; require identical provenance retention and zero instruction/effect authority escape, including downstream adapters and restart/replay paths.
